predecessors.name: Papal States
predecessors.text: the Papal States of 1849, which the Republic claimed after the Pope's flight to Gaeta (the page describes no territory)

successors.name: Papal States
successors.text: restored by the French: 'The French Army entered Rome on 3 July and reestablished the Holy See's temporal power'; Pius IX returned only in April 1850

ledger.x: 9 February 1849: the Roman Republic is proclaimed.
25 April 1849: the French land at Civitavecchia to restore the Pope.
3 July 1849: the Roman Republic falls and papal rule is restored (the pope returned to Rome only in April 1850).
July 1849: the Roman Republic ends after about five months.

wars.name: Siege of Rome (1849)
wars.outcome: French troops under Oudinot landed at Civitavecchia on 25 April 1849, besieged Rome from 1 June, prevailed on 29 June and entered the city on 3 July, restoring the Pope's temporal power; Neapolitan troops also 'entered Roman Republic territory' and Spain sent…

certainty.note: The page names no territory; only Rome and Civitavecchia are placed.
